data.body: The docstring states "Zero disables inline findings," but `limit = max_findings or DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS` treats `0` as falsy, so passing `max_findings=0` silently falls back to `DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS` (20) instead of returning an empty list. This violates the documented contract for the explicit zero case (only `None` should fall back to the default). Fix by distinguishing `None` from `0` explicitly, e.g. `limit = DEFAULT_MAX_FINDINGS if max_findings is None else max_findings`, so `findings[:0]` correctly yields `[]`.
